tools.name: ping
tools.description: Health check that confirms the FXMacroData API and MCP server are reachable. Returns the API health response.

tools.name: mcp_capabilities
tools.description: Explains what the FXMacroData MCP server can do: which tools render MCP Apps, which return plain rows, what is public versus subscriber-only, and how tool selection differs across ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Codex, and plain MCP clients. tools.name: subscribe_for_mcp_access
tools.description: Returns FXMacroData subscription options and a direct checkout path for unlocking MCP app visuals, charts, and advanced analytical tools.

tools.name: data_catalogue
tools.description: List every macroeconomic indicator FXMacroData publishes for a currency, with units, frequency, and coverage/freshness metadata. tools.name: risk_sentiment
tools.description: Return the global risk-on/risk-off sentiment series used for FX regime analysis. Suited to cross-asset regime context for high-beta, safe-haven, commodity, or USD-defensive FX

tools.name: macro_news

tools.name: release_calendar

tools.name: rate_curve

tools.name: rate_differentials

tools.name: macro_briefing_task
tools.description: Build a compact macro briefing for a currency by combining catalogue, key macro series, release-calendar, prediction, news, risk-sentiment, COT, seasonality, and FX technical context. Set depth for one indicator, a regime classification, or a research pack. Access: USD needs no API key; other curren

tools.name: macro_heatmap_task

Set mode for a single-pair market cockpit instead. Access: USD needs no API key; other currencies return subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: geopolitical_history
tools.description: Search stored official sanctions (OFAC) and maritime-security (UKMTO) records by source, country, date or text. tools.name: geopolitical_event
tools.description: Full stored record of one official-source geopolitical event, by event_id, with separate incident, publication and capture dates; as_of returns it as known at a past cutoff. Access: API key required, else returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: geopolitical_event_revisions
tools.description: Every stored revision of one geopolitical event's source record, by event_id, showing how the publisher changed it over time; as_of limits it to what was known at a past cutoff. Access: API key required, else returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: geopolitical_sources
tools.description: Lists the official geopolitical sources held: source_id values, record counts, collection outcomes and coverage limits. Takes no arguments. Access: API key required, else returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: geopolitical_event_reaction
tools.description: Precomputed FX reference-price moves for one currency pair around one geopolitical event, by event_id. Context only: not causation or a trading signal. Access: API key required, else returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: event_impact_replay_task
tools.description: Replay verified publication events against measured 1, 5 and 20-observation FX reference returns. Daily windows exclude the publication-day fixing; changes from previous actuals are not consensus surprises. Access: USD needs no API key; other currencies return subscription_required with a subscribe

tools.name: fx_trade_setup_task
tools.description: Build a trader-oriented FX pair setup using spot context, macro differentials, upcoming catalyst risk, and optional COT positioning. Set view for pair context only or a ranked event-risk score. Access: API key required, else returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: fx_backtest_task
tools.description: Run a spot-only FX backtest using historical policy-rate-differential and/or lagged momentum signals. Downloads complete histories, verifies vintages and price coverage, and charges opening, rebalancing and closing costs. The carry signal does not include funding income or broker rollover. Access: A

tools.name: research_run_list
tools.description: List owned saved studies. Paid, owner-only. No live orders or model inference. Access: API key required, else returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: research_run_read
tools.description: Read one saved study; full report is available in the Research App. Paid, owner-only. No live orders or model inference. Access: API key required, else returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: research_run_submit
tools.description: Queue one bounded research calculation; returns a queued run ID. Paid, owner-only. No live orders or model inference. Access: API key required, else returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: research_run_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a saved research job. Cancellation cannot be undone; completed work may need a new submission. Paid, owner-only. No live orders or model inference. Access: API key required, else returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: research_run_reveal_holdout
tools.description: Irreversibly expose a study holdout and record its exposure. The holdout can no longer be treated as unseen. Paid, owner-only. No live orders or model inference. Access: API key required, else returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: research_paper_list
tools.description: List owned reference paper accounts. Paid, owner-only. No live orders or model inference. Access: API key required, else returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: research_paper_read
tools.description: Read one reference paper account and its versions. Paid, owner-only. No live orders or model inference. Access: API key required, else returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: research_paper_start
tools.description: Create a new reference paper account starting flat at USD 100. Replay is historical. Paid, owner-only. No live orders or model inference. Access: API key required, else returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: research_paper_start_version
tools.description: Archive the current version and start a fresh immutable version flat at USD 100. Discards its active position and pending order without a synthetic closing fill; preserves history. Paid, owner-only. No live orders or model inference. Access: API key required, else returns subscription_required with

tools.name: research_paper_events
tools.description: Read paged paper event summaries; full input evidence remains in the private audit export. Paid, owner-only. No live orders or model inference. Access: API key required, else returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: research_paper_pause
tools.description: Pause new paper entries. Paid, owner-only. No live orders or model inference. Access: API key required, else returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: research_paper_resume
tools.description: Resume paper entries unless risk halted. Paid, owner-only. No live orders or model inference. Access: API key required, else returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: research_paper_flatten
tools.description: Request paper position flattening and discard pending orders; this changes simulated account state. Paid, owner-only. No live orders or model inference. Access: API key required, else returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: research_paper_archive
tools.description: Archive a paper account and its active version. This account cannot be resumed. Paid, owner-only. No live orders or model inference. Access: API key required, else returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: research_paper_journal
tools.description: Read five journal notes per offset, with long text explicitly shortened. Paid, owner-only. No live orders or model inference. Access: API key required, else returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: research_paper_append_journal
tools.description: Append a version-linked journal note; does not modify existing notes. Paid, owner-only. No live orders or model inference. Access: API key required, else returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: research_paper_revise_journal
tools.description: Append a new revision of an existing journal note, retaining the previous revisions. Paid, owner-only. No live orders or model inference. Access: API key required, else returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: market_sessions

tools.description: Find publication-cleared FX industry organisations by name or service, optionally within a business category. tools.name: organisation_profile

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
